title: The commit-msg hook passes no job to apply_trailers and no executor sets KB_JOB and KB_JOB_OPERATOR, so a commit a job makes carries no KB-Job and no submitter
goal: kg_hooks.hook_commit_msg calls kg_trailers.job_trailers(os.environ) and passes its operator and job to apply_trailers, a job's operator replacing session_operator(), and kj_exec.job_env sets KB_JOB to the job id and KB_JOB_OPERATOR to the record's operator for the job's process, so a commit made in a job carries KB-Operator of the submitter and KB-Job

run: import sys,os;sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath("_tools"));import kg_hooks,inspect;sys.exit(0 if "job_trailers" in inspect.getsource(kg_hooks) else 1)

notes: ST-p7oslxrl wires kg_hooks.hook_commit_msg and kj_exec.job_env itself (operator's answer to its gate g2), so this bug's repro passes once that lands
